steps.note: The count docs/design/video-vs-premiere.md keeps: a five minute 2880 by 1800 talking recording (5:19 as it is written) cut to ninety seconds at Next defaults, by keys and ruler clicks only, the way a Premiere editor makes the same cut. Every step below that a person does is one action: a clickRuler is one click on the ruler, a key is one press. Nothing else here is a person's action; waits, checks and pictures are the walk watching. The count is 19: Q to lose the head (2), three marked stretches at I, O and the apostrophe (15), W to lose the tail (2).
